# Chrome Stream MCP **View and interact with your own local Google Chrome tabs right inside Antigravity, even over a slow phone or remote connection.** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-555) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
## Highlights - **Real local Chrome in Antigravity**: Click, type, scroll, navigate, and manage tabs in your existing Chrome profile (accounts and extensions intact). - **Adaptive weak-network streaming**: Automatically scales quality across four RTT-based presets, skips unchanged frames, syncs quietly in the background, and wakes immediately when a kept-alive pane is reopened. - **Clean tab semantics**: Closing the last tab shows a clean empty state instead of forcing an unwanted `about:blank` tab open. ## Install & Setup ### 1. Install the plugin (macOS & Linux) ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` Installs the SHA-256-verified prebuilt binary (macOS Apple Silicon/Intel, Linux x86_64) into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/chrome-stream-mcp`. Pin a version with `CHROME_STREAM_VERSION=v0.3.0`, then reload Antigravity. ### 2. Enable Chrome remote debugging (one-time) 1. Open `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` in your running Google Chrome and enable remote debugging (recommended on **Chrome 136+**; or launch a separate profile with `--remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome-debug`). 2. Open **Chrome Stream** in Antigravity, click **Connect**, and click **Allow** once in Chrome. Run `chrome-stream-mcp doctor` if Chrome doesn't connect. ## Usage Use the panel header's **Connect**, **Pause / Resume**, and **Disconnect** controls directly, or ask your agent via the on-demand skill (zero always-on prompt overhead): | Tool | What it does | | :--- | :--- | | `chrome_stream_stage` | Opens the panel and reports status without auto-connecting. | | `chrome_stream_connect` | Connects to local Chrome and starts streaming the active tab. | | `chrome_stream_disconnect` | Stops streaming and closes the Chrome debugging connection. | **Optional overrides**: Auto-discovers standard macOS/Linux Chrome/Chromium profiles (falling back to localhost `9222`). Override via `CHROME_STREAM_DEBUG_PORT`, `CHROME_STREAM_PORT_FILE`, `CHROME_STREAM_USER_DATA_DIR`, or `CHROME_STREAM_LANG` (`en` / `zh-CN`). ## Architecture & Safety - **Loopback-only (`127.0.0.1` / `::1`)**: Rejects non-loopback targets; never expose Chrome's debugging port publicly. - **Single-approval `0600` local relay**: A user-only (`0600`) Unix socket under `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/chrome-stream-mcp/` keeps the authorized session alive across plugin reloads so you only click **Allow** once per browser session. - **Explicit connect & 12s idle GPU stop**: Opening the panel never auto-dials Chrome; screen capture pauses automatically after 12 seconds of inactivity and wakes on your next interaction. - **Privacy redaction & zero outbound traffic**: Strips local paths and internal WebSocket tokens before reaching the agent, with zero outbound network requests. ## Build from source Requires Rust (`cargo`) and Node.js 20+ (panel build/tests only; zero npm dependencies): ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp.git && cd chrome-stream-mcp node panel/build.mjs && node --test panel/net-policy.test.mjs cargo test --locked && cargo build --release --locked ``` ## Contributing & License See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), and [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

# Chrome Stream MCP **在 Antigravity 里直接查看和操作你本机的 Google Chrome，即使手机远程或弱网环境下也能顺畅使用。** [![CI](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![Release](assets/release-badge.svg)](https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/releases) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) ![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux-555) [English](README.md) | 简体中文
## 核心特性 - **在 Antigravity 内直接操作本机 Chrome**：复用已登录账号与扩展，支持点击、输入、滚轮、地址栏跳转及标签页管理。 - **弱网自适应与后台轻刷**：按 RTT 在四档画质间自动切换，画面未变时零字节跳过，后台低频同步且再次展开面板时秒级刷新。 - **贴合正常浏览器习惯**：关闭最后一个标签页后展示干净空态，不会强行弹回 `about:blank`。 ## 安装与准备 ### 1. 安装插件（macOS 与 Linux） ```sh curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp/main/scripts/install.sh | sh ``` 自动下载并校验 SHA-256 预编译程序（macOS Apple Silicon/Intel、Linux x86_64）至 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/chrome-stream-mcp`；如需指定版本可前置 `CHROME_STREAM_VERSION=v0.3.0`，装完后重载 Antigravity。 ### 2. 开启 Chrome 远程调试（仅需一次） 1. 在运行中的 Google Chrome 打开 `chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging` 并开启远程调试（**Chrome 136+** 推荐；或终端单独启动 `--remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir=/tmp/chrome-debug`）。 2. 在 Antigravity 打开 **Chrome Stream**，点击 **连接 Chrome**，并在 Chrome 弹窗中点一次 **允许**。 如无法连接，可运行 `chrome-stream-mcp doctor` 排查。 ## 使用方式 可直接使用面板顶栏的 **连接**、**暂停 / 继续**、**断开** 按钮，或在对话中通过按需加载的 Skill（平时零上下文开销）让 Agent 调用： | 工具 | 作用 | | :--- | :--- | | `chrome_stream_stage` | 打开面板并查看状态，不会自动连接 Chrome。 | | `chrome_stream_connect` | 连接到本机 Chrome 并开始投屏当前标签页。 | | `chrome_stream_disconnect` | 停止投屏并断开 Chrome 调试连接。 | **可选环境变量**：默认自动扫描 macOS/Linux 常见 Chrome/Chromium 配置目录并回退至本机 `9222` 端口；支持 `CHROME_STREAM_DEBUG_PORT`、`CHROME_STREAM_PORT_FILE`、`CHROME_STREAM_USER_DATA_DIR` 与 `CHROME_STREAM_LANG`（`en` / `zh-CN`）。 ## 架构与安全边界 - **仅限本机环回（`127.0.0.1` / `::1`）**：拒绝任何非环回地址；请勿将 Chrome 调试端口暴露至公网。 - **单次授权 `0600` 本地 Socket 中继**：通过 `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/chrome-stream-mcp/` 下仅当前用户可读写的 `0600` Unix Socket 保活会话，插件重载不反复弹窗。 - **显式触发与 12 秒无操作停流护显卡**：打开面板绝不自动拨号；12 秒无交互自动暂停抓屏让 GPU 休息，下次交互立即唤醒。 - **信息脱敏与零外连**：向 Agent 返回前自动剔除本地路径与内部 WebSocket Token，插件本身不发起任何对外网络请求。 ## 从源码构建 需要 Rust（`cargo`）和 Node.js 20+（仅用于面板打包和测试，零 npm 依赖）： ```sh git clone https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/chrome-stream-mcp.git && cd chrome-stream-mcp node panel/build.mjs && node --test panel/net-policy.test.mjs cargo test --locked && cargo build --release --locked ``` ## 参与贡献与许可证 详见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)、[CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) 和 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。
